messages:
sam: Heads-up — proposing a conservative integration plan for FlashAttention v3 kernels. Goal: enable by default behind a feature flag but ramp slowly with telemetry guards.

maya: +1. Quick summary from the profiler: v3 improves long-seq throughput (~1.2x at seq=4096, bs=4) but we saw 10-18% p50 regression on short-seq generation (seq<=128, bs=1) on some CUDA versions. KV cache path shows extra memcpy on fallback path.

lin: Can you paste the profiling snippet? curious about KV eviction heat.

maya: Here — trimmed outputs from perf run on A100: 
```
baseline flashv2 p50: 28.4ms
flashv3 p50: 33.2ms
throughput (seq4096, bs4): 980 tok/s -> 1180 tok/s
kv-cache: miss-handling adds ~4ms on first token when page-swap occurs
```

ben: Noted. Seems sequence-length distribution matters. Most hosted traffic is short-chat (seq 64 avg). We should not worsen latent p50 there.

sam: Proposal: rollout plan draft —
- gate: ff.attn.kernel = "auto" (chooser picks best by policy)
- on new deploy, set ff.attn.allow_flashv3 = false by default
- canary job: enable allow_flashv3=true for 5% traffic for 12h, gather metrics
- if safe, bump to 25% -> 50% -> 100% with automated checks

lin: Suggest adding a per-customer override so enterprise customers can opt-in earlier. Also: kernel chooser should evaluate per-request heuristics: seq_len, kv_pages, batch_size.

maya: Perf guard rules to implement in telemetry pipeline:
- p50_gen_latency_shortseq (seq<=128, bs==1) must be >= 0.95 * baseline
- kv_eviction_rate should not increase > 2x baseline
- error_rate and OOMs = zero tolerance

sam: Exact automations: if p50_shortseq drops below threshold, trigger automatic flag rollback to ff.attn.allow_flashv3=false and route traffic to flashv2. Need an abort window metric evaluated every 15m.

ops-oncall: Will add alerts for: attn_kernel_change.rollback_candidate, attn_kv_evictions.spike, attn_p50_shortseq_regress. Which metric names do you want?

lin: Use: attn.kernel.chooser.p50.shortseq, attn.kernel.kv.evictions.rate, attn.kernel.error.count.

ben: For safety, implement a soft-fallback in chooser: prefer flashv3 only when (seq_len>256 OR batch_size>1) AND kv_pages<2. Otherwise keep flashv2. That keeps short-chat traffic stable.

maya: Also found one regression on CUDA 12.3 + driver X where shared-memory allocation path for flashv3 falls back to global memory causing 6-8ms penalty. We should add a CUDA-ver check in kernel selector.

sam: Good catch. So kernel selection heuristic = (cuda_ok && seq_policy && kv_policy). Pseudocode: 
```
if cuda_version >= 12.4 and seq_len >= 256 and kv_pages < 2: use flashv3
elif seq_len < 256 and batch_size == 1: use flashv2
else: choose by benchmark-profile table
```

ops-oncall: Deploy bot scheduled canary for 2026-04-02 09:00 UTC. deploy-bot: canary started for release/attn-v3-integration at 2625008000

deploy-bot: canary traffic split = 5% -> 25% -> 50% per plan, manual progression required at each step until automation is live.

ben: Tests we need before canary:
- synthetic microbench script: ./bench/attn_profile --model=gpt2 --seq=64,128,512 --bs=1,4
- kv stress test with page churn: ./bench/kv_eviction_stress --clients=64 --duration=10m
- end-to-end smoke: run sample chat flows concurrently with monitoring.

maya: Also add a perf regression run to CI that compares p50 vs main branch for seq 64/128 nightly. If regression > 5% fail.

lin: For rollout observability, add sampling of kernel_choice per request (random 0.1% sample) with fields: seq_len, batch_size, kv_pages, cuda_version, chosen_kernel, latency_ms.

ops-oncall: Confirmed, will add log keys and dashboards: attn-kernel-chooser (heatmap), p50_shortseq_by_cuda, kv_eviction_timeline.

sam: Ownership: eng-runtime implements chooser + flags (lin, maya), eng-ml verifies benchmarks (ben), ops adds alerts/dashboards (ops-oncall). Canaries start 2026-04-02.

ben: One more: plan a rollback dry-run today to validate the automation path (simulate metric breach and ensure traffic flips back). Can someone trigger?

maya: I'll run a simulated breach against staging in 30m. Command: `./tools/simulate_regression --metric p50_shortseq --multiplier 1.2`

lin: After canary, we should schedule a 48h observation window before full 100% traffic. Keep the flag TTL protected so it can be toggled quickly.

sam: Thanks all — I'll update the runbook with thresholds and the exact flag names, then post the runbook link here. :thumbsup:

sam: runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/attn-flashv3-integration (will update with commands and rollback playbook)
